findings.F1: The volume surge is followed by a rise only while the coin's 30-day return is positive: those cases end +0.72 % above the coin's normal 18-bar drift (t 4.35, 3,856 cases, strength 0.075), while cases after a falling 30 days end −0.54 % (t −3.92, 3,747 cases, strength −0.056), and the plan's pooled measure (+0.20 %, t 1.81) averages the two together.
findings.F2: Inside a rising 30 days the move grows with the surge, from +0.16 % (t 0.52) in the lowest volume-ratio fifth to +0.74 %, +0.53 %, +0.99 % (t 2.68) and +1.14 % (t 2.38) in the highest, about 800 cases each, strength up to 0.10. Inside a falling 30 days no fifth is positive with a t above 0.63. The rank correlation of volume ratio with the 18-bar move is weak in both groups (Spearman 0.010 up, 0.041 down).
findings.F3: The same split shows by year: the bear years 2018 (−1.87 %, t −4.10) and 2022 (−1.24 % weighted, t −4.58) are strongly negative, while 2020, 2021, 2023 and 2024 are positive with t from 2.78 to 3.93. The pooled result is drowned by the market's regime, not weak everywhere.
findings.F4: The supporting check could not pass by construction: 55.8 % of the cases sit at the forecast cap of 20 (median 20), so the upper half held 0 cases. Graded by the raw volume ratio instead, the top two fifths gain +0.70 % (t 2.87) and +0.43 % (t 1.62), against −0.18 % and −0.26 % in the lowest two.
findings.F5: The rise appears mainly after a large 24-hour move with a strong surge. After a 24-hour rise above one usual move, the top two volume fifths end +1.30 % (t 2.57) and +1.28 % (t 2.36). Cases with a flat 24 hours are near zero or negative in every fifth (−0.53 % to +0.10 %).
findings.F6: The pooled effect is on the predicted side but small: 0.14 % per case, a strength of 0.013, which is 0.6 times the 0.22 % cost of a trade. The test already used every coin and fold the 4h bars allow, because hourly bars end in 2025. Inside a rising 30 days the unusual move of 0.72 % to 1.14 % is 3 to 5 times that cost.

ideas.idea: When a coin trades a four-hour volume far above its 30-day average, it rises over the next three days, only while its 30-day return is positive. The higher the volume against that average, the larger the rise.
ideas.consequence: Lean long after a volume surge when the coin's last 30 days are up, and refuse the same long after a falling month.
ideas.name: volume surge in uptrend

ideas.idea: When a coin's 24-hour rise is large against its usual 24-hour move and its latest four-hour volume is far above its 30-day average, it keeps rising over the next three days. The larger the volume against that average, the larger the further rise.
ideas.consequence: A sharp one-day rise carried by a volume surge is a reason to stay with the move for three days rather than fade it.
ideas.name: surge-backed rise continues
